reviewBasis: Read directly from the frozen source's own plain text (markup stripped with no section-segmentation logic applied -- the same neutral extraction a browser's rendered text view would give a human reviewer), independently of parse_ors_chapter.py. Every entry in the chapter's own printed table of contents was cross-checked against a full read of the body text; the three sections the table of contents omits (12.030, 12.133, 12.260) were found by reading past every table-of-contents entry to the next one and confirming each intervening span is a bare-number repealed stub, not a missed catchline.
